description: Ex-Aerolíneas Argentinas/Austral Boeing 737-200 LV-ZYI, abandoned at ENAER (El Bosque) and sold at a Chilean customs auction on 13 April 2014 to businessman Juan Carlos Andrade; trucked to the Motel Paraíso in Quillota in July 2014 to be installed beside the cabins in Aerolíneas Argentinas livery (modocharlie.com). Visible from outside; presence after 2014 not confirmed.
